All cosmetic products must be safe whether sold, given away or used professionally or by the public.
Some cosmetic ingredients are banned and others are restricted.
A new cosmetic must be assessed by a qualified professional before being made available.
Cosmetics made available in Great Britain must be notified to OPSS.
Great Britain consumer cosmetics must have a named Responsible Person with a UK or EU address.
Packaging must provide precautions, quantity, Responsible Person details, batch identification, date information, origin where imported and ingredients.
Required product information must be in English and easy to read.
OPSS advises caution where product information, a Responsible Person or a valid UK or EU address is missing.
Cosmetic risk depends on formulation, concentration, contamination, labelling, user sensitivity, use pattern, storage and product authenticity.
OPSS consumer guidance is product-, ingredient-, user-, supply-chain-, compliance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
